How to use Gemma 4. Google just released Gemma 4, a powerful AI model you can run right on your own computer -- completely free, fully offline, and with total privacy. In this video, I'll walk you through exactly what Gemma 4 is, how to try it in your browser first, and how to install and run it locally step by step using Ollama.
 
Gemma 4 is Google's new open AI model designed to run locally on your machine -- no internet, no subscriptions, and no data leaving your computer. We start by breaking down the different model sizes so you can pick the right one for your hardware. Then I show you how to test it out instantly in Google AI Studio without installing anything. After that, we install Ollama, download the Gemma 4 model, and put it through several real-world prompts including text generation, image understanding, coding, and a tricky math reasoning problem. Whether you're curious about local AI or want a private, free alternative to cloud-based tools, this video has you covered.
